sessionStart.powershell: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path logs | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path logs/session.log -Value "Session started: $(Get-Date)"

userPromptSubmitted.bash: mkdir -p logs && echo "[INFO] $(date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S') - User prompt submitted" >> logs/prompts.log
userPromptSubmitted.powershell: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path logs | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path logs/prompts.log -Value "[INFO] $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss') - User prompt submitted"
